headline: Resident Evil 4: the Devil May Cry secret
title: Resident Evil 4 Facts | Devil May Cry Origin | Classic Games
video_script: Resident Evil four launched in two thousand five on the Nintendo GameCube. You play Leon Kennedy, sent to Spain to rescue the president's daughter, Ashley. Here is the twist. An early version of the game, directed by Hideki Kamiya, felt too different from Resident Evil, so it became a new game, Devil May Cry. Resident Evil four had sold fifteen point two million copies by March twenty twenty five. Best boss fight? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Born from an early RE4 version

description: Resident Evil 4 (Capcom, 2005): an early version directed by Hideki Kamiya became Devil May Cry; 15.2 million copies sold by March 2025. Source: Wikipedia.
